summary: The rich.progress open/wrap_file feature is implemented in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), with tests added to tests/test_progress.py, docs in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md bullet. The diff is additive only and nothing is committed. Nothing was run as instructed, so tests and mypy are unverified. The module-level open passes a plain str mode to the overloaded Progress.open, which mypy may flag.
